semantics.universe: Union of Ontario ARA polygon summaries, ARA survey points and recreational fish stocking records carrying one of the supported trout species. Waterbody Location Identifier entity type is used when available to exclude known non-lakes; unresolved evidence is retained only when ARA type or source naming supports a lake classification.
semantics.speciesEvidence: Each trout species carries its own provenance. Evidence for one trout species never increases another species evidence score.
semantics.remoteness: Precomputed mapped context where coordinates and source responses are available. Missing Remote Context never removes an evidenced trout lake. It is not proof of legal access, road condition, solitude, navigability, fish abundance or catch probability.
